instruction:
Pico-ITX Outline with I/O Cutout

The file /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb is a 100 x 72 mm rectangle at Pico-ITX size, with a few placed components but no I/O cutout and no mounting holes.

Modify the Edge.Cuts outline to add the Pico-ITX I/O bracket cutout, 76 x 7 mm, inset into the +Y edge and centered horizontally. Add four mounting holes at the Pico-ITX corner positions. Ensure no component center falls within 3 mm of the cutout interior. Then export the Edge.Cuts layer as a single-page SVG from the finished board.

Requirements:
1. The board bounding box must remain 100 mm wide by 72 mm tall, within 0.1 mm.
2. The cutout bottom must be a horizontal Edge.Cuts segment at y = 65 mm, spanning 76 mm within 0.1 mm.
3. The cutout side segments must be vertical at x = 12 mm and x = 88 mm, each 7 mm tall within 0.1 mm.
4. Four mounting holes must be present at (3, 3), (97, 3), (3, 69), and (97, 69), each within 0.1 mm.
5. No component center may fall within 3 mm of the cutout region.

Write /home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb and /home/user/Desktop/edgecuts.svg.
